Intel Registration Confirmation
Rejection Email
Account Application Update
Dear {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_First_Name__c} {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_Last_Name__c},
We appreciate your interest in Intel's Developer Zone. Upon review of your application, we regret to inform you that your request for a Premier Account has been declined. There are a variety of reasons why your request may have been declined, including but not limited to not meeting program criteria. You may continue to use your Standard account to:
Bookmark and subscribe to content. Attend events and webinars. Engage in the support forums Enter contests Access performance testing applications Access public documentation and resources Access development software downloads Access the Intel® Developer Cloud . Manage newsletter and product update subscriptions
If you feel your request was declined in error, please contact account assistance via phone (add) or email (add) for more information.
Sincerely, Registration Administrator Developer Zone
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, add us to your address book.
